import sys,json,math

def capsule(length,angle,radius,mm=.8874414):
 half=math.ceil((length/2+radius+2)/mm)
 y,x=np.mgrid[-half:half+1,-half:half+1]*mm
 a=math.radians(angle);u=x*math.cos(a)+y*math.sin(a);v=-x*math.sin(a)+y*math.cos(a)
 d=np.hypot(np.maximum(np.abs(u)-length/2,0),v)
 k=np.clip((radius+.6-d)/1.2,0,1)
 return k,nd.gaussian_filter(k,1/mm)

def plan(path,n=12):
 full=camera_image(path);im=np.array(Image.fromarray(np.uint8(full)).resize((256,256)),float)
 target=np.array(Image.open('/app/target.png').resize((256,256)),float)
 tl=lab(nd.gaussian_filter(target,(1.127,1.127,0)));palette=lab(P)
 templates=[]
 for alpha,rad,depth in [(0.48,2.5,.00125),(.85,2.9,.00165),(1.,3.3,.0025)]:
  for length in [2.,7.,13.]:
   for angle in ([0,90] if length==2 else [0,45,90,135]):
    k,kb=capsule(length,angle,rad);templates.append((alpha,length,angle,depth,k,kb))
 avoid=np.ones((256,256));avoid[:11]=avoid[-11:]=0;avoid[:,:11]=avoid[:,-11:]=0
 plan=[]
 for it in range(n):
  cur=lab(nd.gaussian_filter(im,(1.127,1.127,0)));err=tl-cur;best=None
  for c in range(16):
   delta=palette[c]-cur
   A=2*np.sum(err*delta,axis=-1);B=np.sum(delta*delta,axis=-1)
   for alpha,length,angle,depth,k,kb in templates:
    g=(alpha*signal.fftconvolve(A,kb,mode='same')-alpha**2*signal.fftconvolve(B,kb**2,mode='same'))*avoid
    y,x=np.unravel_index(np.argmax(g),g.shape);gain=g[y,x]
    if best is None or gain>best[0]:best=(gain,c,y,x,alpha,length,angle,depth,k)
  gain,c,y,x,alpha,length,angle,depth,k=best
  angle=math.radians(angle);dx=math.cos(angle)*length/.8874414/2;dy=math.sin(angle)*length/.8874414/2
  pts=[[2*(y-dy),2*(x-dx),depth],[2*(y+dy),2*(x+dx),depth]]
